experiment: Meridian Earth Laboratory 005A: terrain-derived surface analysis

input.authority: Exact final R16 underlying the validated Tryfan Unreal Landscape

curvature.profile: normal curvature in the downslope gradient direction; positive concave-up, negative convex-up
curvature.plan: horizontal contour curvature; positive concave/hollow, negative convex/ridge
curvature.laplacian: d2z/dx2 + d2z/dy2; positive hollow/concave, negative ridge/convex

roughness.algorithm: RMS vertical residual after least-squares local plane removal in a centred square window
roughness.edge_and_nodata_policy: NODATA unless the full window contains valid samples

relationships.interpretation: Relative, potentially overlapping geometry combinations only; never land-cover or material labels. The diagnostic map uses display precedence where combinations overlap.

output.raster_format: GeoTIFF Float32, EPSG:27700, sample centres at Landscape vertices

invariants: Lab 004 camera, overlay, Landscape, transform and R16 remain unchanged.
Derived geometry is evidence, not rock, grass, scree, path or vegetation classification.
No external surface observation is introduced in Lab 005A.
